label: EV-07
command_argv:
set -e; git diff --check; PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import ast, difflib, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, tarfile, tempfile
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from agentic_payment_experiment import PaymentStatus
from tests.trusted_execution.test_known_payment_attempt import KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests
from tests.test_webshop_runtime_gate import WebShopRuntimeGateTest

root=Path(".").resolve()
evidence=root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1/evidence"
parent_diff=root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/execution.diff"
repair_files=(
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py",
 "tests/trusted_execution/test_known_payment_attempt.py",
 "tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py",
)
parent_hashes={
 repair_files[0]:"06fa46c9348403993a946aa820c50b4d331aa1e1f60f92124d33f096e6f3fe84",
 repair_files[1]:"cc2901bcece761687b2c2d4d3e30fc7f2d5b0ccf355e8e7bded79254cb0a9d6c",
 repair_files[2]:"868e7a202e635b4fb2cb5ec25cc3bd2ab98a40ecd65cf487176fcf1f31b39131",
}
unchanged_parent_files=(
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_runtime_gate.py",
 "scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py",
 "samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/__init__.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/__init__.py",
 "tests/test_project_impact_baseline.py",
 "docs/04_验证体系/项目级能力评测基线_v1.md",
)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 data=subprocess.check_output(["git","archive","HEAD"])
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode="r:") as tf:
  tf.extractall(td)
 applied=subprocess.run(["git","apply","--unsafe-paths",str(parent_diff)],cwd=td,text=True,capture_output=True)
 if applied.returncode:
  raise SystemExit(applied.stderr)
 parent_root=Path(td)
 for rel,expected in parent_hashes.items():
  actual=hashlib.sha256((parent_root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  if actual!=expected: raise SystemExit(f"parent hash mismatch {rel}: {actual}")
 chunks=[]
 for rel in repair_files:
  old=(parent_root/rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
  new=(root/rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
  chunks.extend(difflib.unified_diff(old,new,fromfile="a/"+rel,tofile="b/"+rel))
 repair_diff=evidence/"repair.diff"
 repair_diff.write_text("".join(chunks),encoding="utf-8")
 unchanged={rel:(parent_root/rel).read_bytes()==(root/rel).read_bytes() for rel in unchanged_parent_files}

source=(root/repair_files[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
positions={
 "request_read":source.index("attempt_request_ref = attempt.request_id"),
 "unrelated_filter":source.index("if attempt_request_ref != current_request_ref"),
 "status_validation":source.index("status_is_valid = type(attempt.status) is PaymentStatus"),
 "payment_validation":source.index("payment_ref_is_valid ="),
}
tree=ast.parse(source)
calls=[n.func.id if isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) else n.func.attr if isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) else "" for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call)]
imports=sorted({n.names[0].name.split(".")[0] for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Import)}|{((n.module or "").split(".")[0]) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)})

fact_case=KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests(methodName="test_unrelated_succeeded_attempt_does_not_block_or_call_binding")
fact_case.setUp()
unrelated=replace(fact_case.succeeded,payment_id="",request_id="request-other",transaction_object_ref=None,status="INVALID_STATUS")
with patch("agentic_payment_experiment.trusted_execution.known_payment_attempt.verify_payment_execution_binding") as verifier:
 fact=fact_case.derive((unrelated,))
 verifier.assert_not_called()

same_malformed=replace(fact_case.succeeded,payment_id="")
same_fact=fact_case.derive((same_malformed,))
valid_fact=fact_case.derive((fact_case.succeeded,))

gate_case=WebShopRuntimeGateTest(methodName="test_unrelated_succeeded_attempt_is_clear_and_checkout_still_runs")
gate_case.setUp()
unrelated_gate=replace(gate_case.execution,payment_id="",request_id="request-unrelated",transaction_object_ref=None,status="INVALID_STATUS")
outcome,calls_out=gate_case.invoke(governed_action=gate_case.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=(unrelated_gate,))

status_output=subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.quotePath=false","status","--short","--branch"],text=True,encoding="utf-8")
checks={
 "parent_snapshot_reconstructed":True,
 "unrelated_filter_before_status_validation":positions["unrelated_filter"]<positions["status_validation"],
 "unrelated_filter_before_payment_validation":positions["unrelated_filter"]<positions["payment_validation"],
 "p2_verifier_single_call":calls.count("verify_payment_execution_binding")==1,
 "no_forbidden_imports":not(set(imports)&{"os","sys","subprocess","socket","urllib","requests","httpx","pathlib"}),
 "no_forbidden_calls":not(set(calls)&{"open","eval","exec","system","popen","run","call","check_output"}),
 "non_repair_parent_files_unchanged":all(unchanged.values()),
 "target_hash_unchanged":hashlib.sha256((root/"samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="f5dc05501c79958b197ea7a727e12660756145da870b897496a9ccac714cacee",
 "runner_hash_unchanged":hashlib.sha256((root/"scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="a7d71fd92cacd7ebdb8e4a1da383067aa57b0e6dcbf20c41f043f4e461fc1fc4",
 "fact_unrelated_malformed_clear":fact.status.value=="CLEAR",
 "fact_same_malformed_indeterminate":same_fact.status.value=="INDETERMINATE",
 "fact_same_valid_blocked":valid_fact.status.value=="BLOCKED",
 "gate_unrelated_malformed_allows":outcome.decision.value=="ALLOW" and outcome.callback_count==1 and calls_out==["checkout"],
}
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("UNCHANGED_PARENT_FILES="+json.dumps(unchanged,sort_keys=True))
print("POSITIONS="+json.dumps(positions,sort_keys=True))
print("FACT_UNRELATED="+json.dumps(fact.to_dict(),sort_keys=True))
print("FACT_SAME_MALFORMED="+json.dumps(same_fact.to_dict(),sort_keys=True))
print("FACT_SAME_VALID="+json.dumps(valid_fact.to_dict(),sort_keys=True))
print("GATE_UNRELATED="+json.dumps({"decision":outcome.decision.value,"callback_count":outcome.callback_count,"calls":calls_out,"preflight":outcome.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.to_dict()},sort_keys=True))
print("REPAIR_DIFF_BYTES="+str(repair_diff.stat().st_size))
print("REPAIR_DIFF_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(repair_diff.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("FINAL_FILE_HASHES="+json.dumps({rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in repair_files},sort_keys=True))
print("STATUS_START")
print(status_output,end="")
print("STATUS_END")
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
